Source: git commit 3959388060e2687324dd88617d82c3519309fc31 of the hall-looks repo. Files: 68 (27 text files stored as readable strings, 41 binary files stored as base64) Bytes: 10061000 Requirements: Python 3.6+ and the standard library only. No network access. Usage: python3 rebuild_heavy_is_the_crown.py # write + verify python3 rebuild_heavy_is_the_crown.py --serve # write + verify, then serve on http://localhost:8000/ python3 rebuild_heavy_is_the_crown.py --out DIR # write somewhere other than ./heavy-is-the-crown python3 rebuild_heavy_is_the_crown.py --verify-only # only check an existing output folder How the data is stored: * Text files (html, css, js, svg, .nojekyll) are raw triple-quoted strings (r\"\"\"...\"\"\") holding the exact file text. They are written as UTF-8 with "\\n" line endings, exactly as in the repo. A file that cannot be stored as a raw string would fall back to an escaped string or base64. * Binary files (images) are base64 strings, wrapped at 76 characters. * forge/index.html is a text file but carries six images inline as data: URIs (long base64 runs inside the HTML); that is how the original file is written, not an artifact of this script. The site has no build step: the written folder is the deployable site. Host it on any static file host; all links between pages are relative, so it also works under a subpath (such as /hall-looks/ on GitHub Pages). HEAVY IS THE CROWN — Help























    HEAVY IS THE CROWNRoomFoundationBlack ChromeWhite SamuraiSkull ChampionTitan GladiatorForgeSmithColosseumCreateHelpLocker
    

    
  
    A friendly field guide
    
  
    Help
    
  
    Start with a Look, build on the Forge, and keep your favorites in the Locker. Every control on this site does what its label says, right away.
    
  
    
    
    
      
    How do I say a character?
    
      
    Open Create and tap short names: ancestry (Elf is there), origin (Dark wood is there), then build, weapon, and a rank. A figure is drawn from your picks, and the page writes a markdown sheet. Say the line at the top, like elf, dark wood.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    How do I design a character?
    
      
      
        
    1. Open Forge.
      2. 
        
    2. Pick the left or right figure, then one of the four looks, or keep the blank figure.
      3. 
        
    3. Change helmet, chest, finish, color, weapon and the eight sliders.
      4. 
        
    4. Open Locker at the top and press Save to locker.
      5. 
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
    What are Looks?
    
      
    Looks are ready-made fighters: Foundation, Black Chrome, White Samurai, Skull Champion, and Titan Gladiator. On the four fighter pages, each style button shows a separate picture of that fighter, made ahead of time. The prompt box there writes words only; it does not draw.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Forge sliders
    
      
      
        
    • Wear — how worn the armor looks.
      • 
        
    • Cracks — how many cracks show in the armor.
      • 
        
    • Armor glow — how bright the armor lights are (drawn on the blank figure).
      • 
        
    • Weapon length — how long the weapon is.
      • 
        
    • Battle damage — dents, burns and chips on the weapon.
      • 
        
    • Weapon glow — how bright the weapon glows.
      • 
        
    • Muscle — how heavy the build is.
      • 
        
    • Height — how tall the figure stands.
      • 
      
    
      
    The three weapon sliders and Armor glow draw on the blank figure. On one of the four looks they change the spec only.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Forge buttons
    
      
      
        
    • Copy spec — copies the settings as text.
      • 
        
    • Save spec file — downloads the settings as a file.
      • 
        
    • Save picture — downloads a picture of the canvas.
      • 
        
    • Save to locker — keeps the character in your locker on this browser.
      • 
        
    • Load — puts a saved character on the selected figure.
      • 
        
    • Remove — deletes a saved character, after you confirm.
      • 
        
    • Keep today's crown — keeps today's crown for good. Then it reads Crown kept until tomorrow.
      • 
      
    
      
    Load and Remove only show next to a saved character.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    What is Locker?
    
      
    Locker is one locker for the whole site, kept in this browser on this device. It holds 24. Saves from Forge, Create, Foundation and the Locker roster all land there. The page background follows the highest saved rank, and only Prism (rank 24) is holographic.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Smith and Colosseum
    
      
    Smith shows the weapon picture that goes with each look; your note shows beside it as words. Colosseum shows one fight picture for each pairing of two different looks, made ahead of time. No fight is simulated.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    House rules
    
      
      
        
    • There is no currency anywhere.
      • 
        
    • Level shows only as armor wear.
      • 
        
    • One crown war a day.
      • 
        
    • The hall of champions is not a live ranking. It updates only when someone has a crown and a full locker of 24.
      • 
        
    • The ultimate champion gets a custom crown and an iridescent, holographic locker character.
      • 
        
    • Ranking is by originality, difficulty, creativeness, realistic application and rarity.
      • 
        
    • Trades are barter only and need both sides to agree. They cover saved characters, weapons, armor, designs and techniques.
      • 
        
    • Outside sellers get only the pay-to-play practice zone, with practice swords and commoner clothing.
      • 
      
    
      
    These are the rules of the game. This site does not run crown wars, trades, rankings or a practice zone yet; it has no accounts and nothing leaves your browser.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Common questions
    
      
      
        
    • Can I start over? Yes. Clear the Locker to remove its saved characters. Crowns stay.
      • 
        
    • Why did the background change? It takes the color of your single highest saved rank.
      • 
        
    • Why is only one rank shiny? Prism is the one holographic rank by design.
      • 
        
    • Will my locker follow me? No. It lives in this browser only.
      • 
      
    
    
    
  
    

    






""")

// (foundation-locker-v2, foundation-locker-crowns-v1, foundation-locker-board-v1), cap 24.
// Saved in this browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
(function () {
  var KEY = "foundation-locker-v2";
  var CROWN_KEY = "foundation-locker-crowns-v1";
  var BOARD_KEY = "foundation-locker-board-v1";
  var CAPACITY = 24;
  // Same look settings the Forge page uses for its four presets, so a look saved here loads there.
  var PRESETS = [
    { look: "black-chrome", name: "Black Chrome", finish: "chrome", helmet: "chrome", chest: "tactical", weapon: "hammer", accent: "#0A0A0B" },
    { look: "white-samurai", name: "White Samurai", finish: "white", helmet: "samurai", chest: "samurai", weapon: "katana", accent: "#FFFFFF" },
    { look: "skull-champion", name: "Skull Champion", finish: "black", helmet: "skull", chest: "tactical", weapon: "axe", accent: "#9AA0A8" },
    { look: "titan-gladiator", name: "Titan Gladiator", finish: "chrome", helmet: "titan", chest: "gladiator", weapon: "hammer", accent: "#FFAA00" }
  ];
  function blankState() {
    return { preset: null, desc: "", prompt: "", touched: false, helmet: "none", chest: "light", finish: "white", weapon: "katana", wear: 8, crack: 12, glow: 9, color: "#E8E8E8", wLen: 50, wWear: 40, wGlow: 8, mus: 50, height: 50, baseHelmet: "none", baseChest: "light", baseFinish: "white", baseColor: "#E8E8E8", baseWeapon: "katana", baseWear: 8, baseCrack: 12, baseGlow: 9, baseWLen: 50, baseWWear: 40, baseWGlow: 8, baseMus: 50, baseHeight: 50, basePrompt: "", baseDesc: "" };
  }
  function presetIndex(look) {
    for (var i = 0; i < PRESETS.length; i++) if (PRESETS[i].look === look) return i;
    return -1;
  }
  function presetState(look) {
    var i = presetIndex(look);
    var s = blankState();
    if (i < 0) return s;
    var p = PRESETS[i];
    s.preset = i; s.touched = true;
    s.helmet = s.baseHelmet = p.helmet;
    s.chest = s.baseChest = p.chest;
    s.finish = s.baseFinish = p.finish;
    s.weapon = s.baseWeapon = p.weapon;
    s.color = s.baseColor = p.accent;
    s.mus = s.baseMus = 75;
    s.height = s.baseHeight = 65;
    return s;
  }
  function readList(key) {
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (!raw) return [];
      var data = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(data) ? data.slice() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function writeList(key, list) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(list)); return { ok: true }; }
    catch (e) { return { ok: false, reason: "Browser storage is not available or full. Nothing was saved." }; }
  }
  function entries() {
    var list = readList(KEY);
    if (list === null) return null;
    return list.filter(function (x) { return x && x.id && x.state && typeof x.state === "object"; }).slice(0, CAPACITY);
  }
  function earnBoard(list) {
    if (!list || list.length < CAPACITY) return false;
    var crowns = readList(CROWN_KEY), board = readList(BOARD_KEY);
    if (crowns === null || board === null) return false;
    var changed = false;
    crowns.forEach(function (crown) {
      if (!crown || !crown.id) return;
      var exists = board.some(function (b) { return b && b.crownId === crown.id; });
      if (exists) return;
      board.push({ id: "board-" + crown.id, crownId: crown.id, day: crown.day, locker: "full" });
      changed = true;
    });
    return changed ? writeList(BOARD_KEY, board).ok : false;
  }
  function add(fields) {
    var list = entries();
    if (list === null) return { ok: false, reason: "The saved locker could not be read, so nothing was replaced." };
    if (list.length >= CAPACITY) return { ok: false, reason: "The locker is full (" + CAPACITY + "). Remove one to save another." };
    var entry = {
      id: "l-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6),
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      fig: 0,
      label: fields.label,
      residual: null, // nothing on this page measures changed settings
      state: fields.state || blankState(),
      thumb: fields.thumb || "",
      source: fields.source,
      look: fields.look || null
    };
    var next = list.concat([entry]);
    var w = writeList(KEY, next);
    if (!w.ok) return w;
    return { ok: true, entry: entry, earned: earnBoard(next) };
  }
  function remove(test) {
    var list = entries();
    if (list === null) return { ok: false, reason: "The saved locker could not be read, so nothing was removed." };
    var next = list.filter(function (x) { return !test(x); });
    if (next.length === list.length) return { ok: true, missing: true };
    return writeList(KEY, next);
  }

    KEY: KEY, CROWN_KEY: CROWN_KEY, BOARD_KEY: BOARD_KEY, CAPACITY: CAPACITY, PRESETS: PRESETS,

    hasLook: function (look) { var list = entries() || []; return list.some(function (x) { return x.look === look; }); }
  };
})();

const hero = document.getElementById("hero");
const empty = document.getElementById("empty");
const shown = document.getElementById("shown");
const prompt = document.getElementById("prompt");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const lookBtns = [...document.querySelectorAll("#looks [data-look]")];
const weaponBtns = [...document.querySelectorAll("#weapons [data-weapon]")];

const weaponSrc = {
  hammer: "../images/weapon-hammer.jpg",
  katana: "../images/weapon-katana.jpg",
  axe: "../images/weapon-axe.jpg",
  warhammer: "../images/weapon-warhammer.jpg"
};
const weaponAlt = {
  hammer: "Black Chrome hammer",
  katana: "White Samurai katana",
  axe: "Skull Champion axe",
  warhammer: "Titan war hammer"
};

let weapon = null;

function front() {
  stage.classList.add("front");
  stage.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
}

function setPressed(list, active) {
  list.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", btn === active ? "true" : "false");
  });
}

function showWeapon(id) {
  const text = prompt.value.trim();
  const name = id ? weaponAlt[id] : "";
  shown.hidden = !name && !text;
  shown.textContent = name + (text ? (name ? " · " : "") + "Your note: " + text : "");

  if (!id) {
    hero.hidden = true;
    hero.removeAttribute("src");
    empty.hidden = false;
    empty.textContent = "Pick a look and a weapon. What you set comes to the front.";
    front();
    return;
  }
  hero.onload = () => {
    hero.hidden = false;
    empty.hidden = true;
    front();
  };
  hero.onerror = () => {
    hero.hidden = true;
    empty.hidden = false;
    empty.textContent = "The " + weaponAlt[id] + " picture did not load.";
    front();
  };
  hero.alt = weaponAlt[id];
  hero.src = weaponSrc[id];
  front();
}

function applyWeapon(id) {
  weapon = id;
  const match = weaponBtns.find((b) => b.dataset.weapon === id);
  if (match) setPressed(weaponBtns, match);
  showWeapon(id);
}

lookBtns.forEach((btn) => {
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (window.heavyPulse) window.heavyPulse(10);
    setPressed(lookBtns, btn);
    applyWeapon(btn.dataset.weapon);
    status.textContent = "";
  });
});

weaponBtns.forEach((btn) => {
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (window.heavyPulse) window.heavyPulse(10);
    applyWeapon(btn.dataset.weapon);
    status.textContent = "";
  });
});

document.getElementById("set").addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (!weapon) {
    status.textContent = "Pick a look or a weapon first.";
    return;
  }
  if (window.heavyPulse) window.heavyPulse(16);
  const text = prompt.value.trim();
  status.textContent = "Showing the " + weaponAlt[weapon] + "." + (text ? " Your note is shown with it." : "");
  showWeapon(weapon);
});

// Weapon thumbs
weaponBtns.forEach((btn) => {
  const slot = btn.querySelector(".weapon-slot");
  const img = document.createElement("img");
  img.alt = "";
  img.decoding = "async";
  img.onerror = () => { slot.textContent = "—"; slot.classList.add("weapon-missing"); };
  img.src = weaponSrc[btn.dataset.weapon];
  slot.replaceChildren(img);
});
""")

/* Locker ranks, lowest to highest. Rank 24 alone is holographic. */
/* Roster: one column per rank that has characters, side by side. */
#roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 24px 18px; align-items: start; }
#roster .tier-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
#roster .tier-heading { font-size: 1.6rem; }
@media (max-width: 640px) { #roster { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px 12px; } #roster .tier-heading { font-size: 1.25rem; } }
.tier-heading {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.tier-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 18px; }
.tier-pip {
  width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; flex: none;
  background: var(--tier, #9a9691);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--tier, #9a9691);
}
.tier-heading .tier-pip { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.rank-ladder {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 6px 0 34px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.rank-ladder li {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px 14px 16px;
  min-height: 0;
  background: rgba(8,8,10,.62);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--tier, #888) 75%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--tier, #888) 22%, transparent);
}
.rank-ladder li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto -20% -45% -20%;
  height: 80%;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tier, #888) 45%, transparent), transparent 68%);
}
.rank-no { display: block; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: .22em; opacity: .8; }
.rank-ladder strong { display: block; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; }
.rank-ladder em { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .72rem; opacity: .85; }
.rank-ladder .tier-apex { grid-column: 1 / -1; min-height: 132px; }
.tier-apex .tier-pip {
  background: conic-gradient(#7af0ff, #f0abfc, #fde68a, #6ee7b7, #7af0ff);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(180,230,255,.8);
}
.rank-ladder .tier-apex { isolation: isolate; border-color: transparent; }
.rank-ladder .tier-apex::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -50%;
  height: auto;
  z-index: 0;
  background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, #67e8ff, #f0abfc, #fde68a, #6ee7b7, #a5b4fc, #67e8ff);
  animation: holo-spin 8s linear infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.rank-ladder .tier-apex::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 2px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 50% at 12% 0%, rgba(103,232,255,.42), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(60% 45% at 100% 10%, rgba(240,171,252,.38), transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(50% 40% at 50% 100%, rgba(253,230,138,.28), transparent 55%),
    #101014;
}
.rank-ladder .tier-apex > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
@keyframes holo-spin { to { transform: rotate(1turn); } }
@media (max-width: 980px) {

/* Help */
.help {
  max-width: 980px;
  padding: 56px 7vw 96px;
}
.help h1 {
  font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif;

  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

/* Immediate control feedback */
button { transition: transform .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, background-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
button:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }
button:focus-visible, [role="button"]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 3px; }
.rank-ladder li[role="button"] { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
.rank-ladder li[role="button"]:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }
